dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a pronounced concave spline curvature with a significant inward arc from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius apex, morphologically classified as rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin displays a steep linear slope estimated at 55-60 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Ratio of maximum pixel base width to vertical pixel height is approximately 1.6:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct small V-shaped notch is visible on the trailing edge just distal to the apex; extensive white punctate markings/speckling across the visible dorsal and lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Densely distributed white micro-speckling pattern against a dark charcoal-colored integument.
